name: Modbus TCP
description: Bounded native Modbus TCP reads and confirmed equipment writes, exact register numerics and register-map helpers.

permissions.description: Native standard Modbus TCP through retained builtin-only client. Explicit host/port/unit, bounded single request and confirmed equipment writes; no authentication/secrets/TLS or automatic retries. Filesystem metadata is conservatively declared because static audit classifies client.open() as local open; reviewed emitted code imports only node:net/events and performs no local file access. Event ingress requires explicit administrator profiles, saved secret references and provider/relay setup. Installation never provisions subscriptions or executes trigger code.

definitions.name: Modbus Read Coils (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
One fresh TCP connection and one request, retries=0. Addresses are zero-based protocol offsets 0..65535; 40001 means holding register address0 only with explicit reference conversion. Unit1..255 (broadcast0 rejected). Standard TCP has no TLS/authentication; no secrets are read. Optional config.$connection resolves RuntimeConnection.config; credentials ignored. Total wall deadline begins before profile/import and all late continuations check it. Every write requires request.confirm=true, may have an uncertain outcome on failure and is never retried. No automatic replay. Reads <=2000 bits/125 registers, write coils<=1968/registers<=123, FC23 writes<=121. Strict bounded MBAP transaction/protocol/unit/length/function and reply correlation. No equipment has been used for validation. modbus-serial@8.0.25 embedded with ISC notices. Sources: https://www.modbus.org/modbus-specifications https://www.modbus.org/file/secure/modbusprotocolspecification.pdf https://www.modbus.org/file/secure/messagingimplementationguide.pdf https://github.com/yaacov/node-modbus-serial

Semantic authoring: new logical ID with direct typed wrapper fields. Prior operation remains compatible. Absence/null/falsy, confirmations and provider behavior are preserved; typed result outputs remain alongside direct fields. No extra provider call.

definitions.name: Modbus Read Discrete Inputs (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
One fresh TCP connection and one request, retries=0. Addresses are zero-based protocol offsets 0..65535; 40001 means holding register address0 only with explicit reference conversion. Unit1..255 (broadcast0 rejected). Standard TCP has no TLS/authentication; no secrets are read. Optional config.$connection resolves RuntimeConnection.config; credentials ignored. Total wall deadline begins before profile/import and all late continuations check it. Every write requires request.confirm=true, may have an uncertain outcome on failure and is never retried. No automatic replay. Reads <=2000 bits/125 registers, write coils<=1968/registers<=123, FC23 writes<=121. Strict bounded MBAP transaction/protocol/unit/length/function and reply correlation. No equipment has been used for validation. modbus-serial@8.0.25 embedded with ISC notices. Sources: https://www.modbus.org/modbus-specifications https://www.modbus.org/file/secure/modbusprotocolspecification.pdf https://www.modbus.org/file/secure/messagingimplementationguide.pdf https://github.com/yaacov/node-modbus-serial

Semantic authoring: new logical ID with direct typed wrapper fields. Prior operation remains compatible. Absence/null/falsy, confirmations and provider behavior are preserved; typed result outputs remain alongside direct fields. No extra provider call.

definitions.name: Modbus Read Holding Registers (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
One fresh TCP connection and one request, retries=0. Addresses are zero-based protocol offsets 0..65535; 40001 means holding register address0 only with explicit reference conversion. Unit1..255 (broadcast0 rejected). Standard TCP has no TLS/authentication; no secrets are read. Optional config.$connection resolves RuntimeConnection.config; credentials ignored. Total wall deadline begins before profile/import and all late continuations check it. Every write requires request.confirm=true, may have an uncertain outcome on failure and is never retried. No automatic replay. Reads <=2000 bits/125 registers, write coils<=1968/registers<=123, FC23 writes<=121. Strict bounded MBAP transaction/protocol/unit/length/function and reply correlation. No equipment has been used for validation. modbus-serial@8.0.25 embedded with ISC notices. Sources: https://www.modbus.org/modbus-specifications https://www.modbus.org/file/secure/modbusprotocolspecification.pdf https://www.modbus.org/file/secure/messagingimplementationguide.pdf https://github.com/yaacov/node-modbus-serial

Semantic authoring: new logical ID with direct typed wrapper fields. Prior operation remains compatible. Absence/null/falsy, confirmations and provider behavior are preserved; typed result outputs remain alongside direct fields. No extra provider call.

definitions.name: Modbus Read Input Registers (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
One fresh TCP connection and one request, retries=0. Addresses are zero-based protocol offsets 0..65535; 40001 means holding register address0 only with explicit reference conversion. Unit1..255 (broadcast0 rejected). Standard TCP has no TLS/authentication; no secrets are read. Optional config.$connection resolves RuntimeConnection.config; credentials ignored. Total wall deadline begins before profile/import and all late continuations check it. Every write requires request.confirm=true, may have an uncertain outcome on failure and is never retried. No automatic replay. Reads <=2000 bits/125 registers, write coils<=1968/registers<=123, FC23 writes<=121. Strict bounded MBAP transaction/protocol/unit/length/function and reply correlation. No equipment has been used for validation. modbus-serial@8.0.25 embedded with ISC notices. Sources: https://www.modbus.org/modbus-specifications https://www.modbus.org/file/secure/modbusprotocolspecification.pdf https://www.modbus.org/file/secure/messagingimplementationguide.pdf https://github.com/yaacov/node-modbus-serial

Semantic authoring: new logical ID with direct typed wrapper fields. Prior operation remains compatible. Absence/null/falsy, confirmations and provider behavior are preserved; typed result outputs remain alongside direct fields. No extra provider call.

definitions.name: Modbus Write Coil (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
One fresh TCP connection and one request, retries=0. Addresses are zero-based protocol offsets 0..65535; 40001 means holding register address0 only with explicit reference conversion. Unit1..255 (broadcast0 rejected). Standard TCP has no TLS/authentication; no secrets are read. Optional config.$connection resolves RuntimeConnection.config; credentials ignored. Total wall deadline begins before profile/import and all late continuations check it. Every write requires request.confirm=true, may have an uncertain outcome on failure and is never retried. No automatic replay. Reads <=2000 bits/125 registers, write coils<=1968/registers<=123, FC23 writes<=121. Strict bounded MBAP transaction/protocol/unit/length/function and reply correlation. No equipment has been used for validation. modbus-serial@8.0.25 embedded with ISC notices. Sources: https://www.modbus.org/modbus-specifications https://www.modbus.org/file/secure/modbusprotocolspecification.pdf https://www.modbus.org/file/secure/messagingimplementationguide.pdf https://github.com/yaacov/node-modbus-serial

Semantic authoring: new logical ID with direct typed wrapper fields. Prior operation remains compatible. Absence/null/falsy, confirmations and provider behavior are preserved; typed result outputs remain alongside direct fields. No extra provider call.

definitions.name: Modbus Write Register (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
One fresh TCP connection and one request, retries=0. Addresses are zero-based protocol offsets 0..65535; 40001 means holding register address0 only with explicit reference conversion. Unit1..255 (broadcast0 rejected). Standard TCP has no TLS/authentication; no secrets are read. Optional config.$connection resolves RuntimeConnection.config; credentials ignored. Total wall deadline begins before profile/import and all late continuations check it. Every write requires request.confirm=true, may have an uncertain outcome on failure and is never retried. No automatic replay. Reads <=2000 bits/125 registers, write coils<=1968/registers<=123, FC23 writes<=121. Strict bounded MBAP transaction/protocol/unit/length/function and reply correlation. No equipment has been used for validation. modbus-serial@8.0.25 embedded with ISC notices. Sources: https://www.modbus.org/modbus-specifications https://www.modbus.org/file/secure/modbusprotocolspecification.pdf https://www.modbus.org/file/secure/messagingimplementationguide.pdf https://github.com/yaacov/node-modbus-serial

Semantic authoring: new logical ID with direct typed wrapper fields. Prior operation remains compatible. Absence/null/falsy, confirmations and provider behavior are preserved; typed result outputs remain alongside direct fields. No extra provider call.

definitions.name: Modbus Write Coils (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
One fresh TCP connection and one request, retries=0. Addresses are zero-based protocol offsets 0..65535; 40001 means holding register address0 only with explicit reference conversion. Unit1..255 (broadcast0 rejected). Standard TCP has no TLS/authentication; no secrets are read. Optional config.$connection resolves RuntimeConnection.config; credentials ignored. Total wall deadline begins before profile/import and all late continuations check it. Every write requires request.confirm=true, may have an uncertain outcome on failure and is never retried. No automatic replay. Reads <=2000 bits/125 registers, write coils<=1968/registers<=123, FC23 writes<=121. Strict bounded MBAP transaction/protocol/unit/length/function and reply correlation. No equipment has been used for validation. modbus-serial@8.0.25 embedded with ISC notices. Sources: https://www.modbus.org/modbus-specifications https://www.modbus.org/file/secure/modbusprotocolspecification.pdf https://www.modbus.org/file/secure/messagingimplementationguide.pdf https://github.com/yaacov/node-modbus-serial

Semantic authoring: new logical ID with direct typed wrapper fields. Prior operation remains compatible. Absence/null/falsy, confirmations and provider behavior are preserved; typed result outputs remain alongside direct fields. No extra provider call.

definitions.name: Modbus Write Registers (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
One fresh TCP connection and one request, retries=0. Addresses are zero-based protocol offsets 0..65535; 40001 means holding register address0 only with explicit reference conversion. Unit1..255 (broadcast0 rejected). Standard TCP has no TLS/authentication; no secrets are read. Optional config.$connection resolves RuntimeConnection.config; credentials ignored. Total wall deadline begins before profile/import and all late continuations check it. Every write requires request.confirm=true, may have an uncertain outcome on failure and is never retried. No automatic replay. Reads <=2000 bits/125 registers, write coils<=1968/registers<=123, FC23 writes<=121. Strict bounded MBAP transaction/protocol/unit/length/function and reply correlation. No equipment has been used for validation. modbus-serial@8.0.25 embedded with ISC notices. Sources: https://www.modbus.org/modbus-specifications https://www.modbus.org/file/secure/modbusprotocolspecification.pdf https://www.modbus.org/file/secure/messagingimplementationguide.pdf https://github.com/yaacov/node-modbus-serial

Semantic authoring: new logical ID with direct typed wrapper fields. Prior operation remains compatible. Absence/null/falsy, confirmations and provider behavior are preserved; typed result outputs remain alongside direct fields. No extra provider call.

definitions.name: Modbus Mask Write Register (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
One fresh TCP connection and one request, retries=0. Addresses are zero-based protocol offsets 0..65535; 40001 means holding register address0 only with explicit reference conversion. Unit1..255 (broadcast0 rejected). Standard TCP has no TLS/authentication; no secrets are read. Optional config.$connection resolves RuntimeConnection.config; credentials ignored. Total wall deadline begins before profile/import and all late continuations check it. Every write requires request.confirm=true, may have an uncertain outcome on failure and is never retried. No automatic replay. Reads <=2000 bits/125 registers, write coils<=1968/registers<=123, FC23 writes<=121. Strict bounded MBAP transaction/protocol/unit/length/function and reply correlation. No equipment has been used for validation. modbus-serial@8.0.25 embedded with ISC notices. Sources: https://www.modbus.org/modbus-specifications https://www.modbus.org/file/secure/modbusprotocolspecification.pdf https://www.modbus.org/file/secure/messagingimplementationguide.pdf https://github.com/yaacov/node-modbus-serial

Semantic authoring: new logical ID with direct typed wrapper fields. Prior operation remains compatible. Absence/null/falsy, confirmations and provider behavior are preserved; typed result outputs remain alongside direct fields. No extra provider call.

definitions.name: Modbus Read Write Registers (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
One fresh TCP connection and one request, retries=0. Addresses are zero-based protocol offsets 0..65535; 40001 means holding register address0 only with explicit reference conversion. Unit1..255 (broadcast0 rejected). Standard TCP has no TLS/authentication; no secrets are read. Optional config.$connection resolves RuntimeConnection.config; credentials ignored. Total wall deadline begins before profile/import and all late continuations check it. Every write requires request.confirm=true, may have an uncertain outcome on failure and is never retried. No automatic replay. Reads <=2000 bits/125 registers, write coils<=1968/registers<=123, FC23 writes<=121. Strict bounded MBAP transaction/protocol/unit/length/function and reply correlation. No equipment has been used for validation. modbus-serial@8.0.25 embedded with ISC notices. Sources: https://www.modbus.org/modbus-specifications https://www.modbus.org/file/secure/modbusprotocolspecification.pdf https://www.modbus.org/file/secure/messagingimplementationguide.pdf https://github.com/yaacov/node-modbus-serial

Semantic authoring: new logical ID with direct typed wrapper fields. Prior operation remains compatible. Absence/null/falsy, confirmations and provider behavior are preserved; typed result outputs remain alongside direct fields. No extra provider call.

definitions.name: Modbus Decode Register Map (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
Pure bounded register/address helper. No network, state or secrets. Register words are unsigned16, byte order applies within each word; word order reverses 16-bit words. IEEE754 finite float32/64; uint64/int64 use canonical exact decimal text, never Number. Modicon five-digit notation addresses0..9998; six-digit0..65535; human notation is explicit. Bit0 is least significant. https://www.modbus.org/modbus-specifications https://www.modbus.org/file/secure/modbusprotocolspecification.pdf https://www.modbus.org/file/secure/messagingimplementationguide.pdf https://github.com/yaacov/node-modbus-serial

Semantic authoring: new logical ID with direct typed wrapper fields. Prior operation remains compatible. Absence/null/falsy, confirmations and provider behavior are preserved; typed result outputs remain alongside direct fields. No extra provider call.

definitions.name: Modbus Register To Bits (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
Pure bounded register/address helper. No network, state or secrets. Register words are unsigned16, byte order applies within each word; word order reverses 16-bit words. IEEE754 finite float32/64; uint64/int64 use canonical exact decimal text, never Number. Modicon five-digit notation addresses0..9998; six-digit0..65535; human notation is explicit. Bit0 is least significant. https://www.modbus.org/modbus-specifications https://www.modbus.org/file/secure/modbusprotocolspecification.pdf https://www.modbus.org/file/secure/messagingimplementationguide.pdf https://github.com/yaacov/node-modbus-serial

Semantic authoring: new logical ID with direct typed wrapper fields. Prior operation remains compatible. Absence/null/falsy, confirmations and provider behavior are preserved; typed result outputs remain alongside direct fields. No extra provider call.

definitions.name: Modbus Slice Registers (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
Pure bounded register/address helper. No network, state or secrets. Register words are unsigned16, byte order applies within each word; word order reverses 16-bit words. IEEE754 finite float32/64; uint64/int64 use canonical exact decimal text, never Number. Modicon five-digit notation addresses0..9998; six-digit0..65535; human notation is explicit. Bit0 is least significant. https://www.modbus.org/modbus-specifications https://www.modbus.org/file/secure/modbusprotocolspecification.pdf https://www.modbus.org/file/secure/messagingimplementationguide.pdf https://github.com/yaacov/node-modbus-serial

Semantic authoring: new logical ID with direct typed wrapper fields. Prior operation remains compatible. Absence/null/falsy, confirmations and provider behavior are preserved; typed result outputs remain alongside direct fields. No extra provider call.

definitions.name: Modbus Registers Changed (Relay) Event
definitions.description: Typed event emitted by Modbus Registers Changed (Relay).
definitions.documentation: Event output contract for Modbus Registers Changed (Relay). This trigger accepts the canonical version-1 modbus-tcp envelope only; it does not authenticate or decode native provider requests. Required exact provider verification: Deploy an independently managed read-only Modbus TCP sampling relay restricted to intended unit IDs/register ranges, read function codes 1–4 and authorized private network. Do not expose device TCP ports publicly or issue write functions. Mapping: Relay compares bounded read-only samples and emits registers.changed only after an actual value change; its first observation seeds a baseline unless explicitly authorized otherwise. Include unit ID, register table, zero-based start address and complete bounded old/new values. Relay assigns durable delivery IDs and observation timestamps. Canonical eventType values: registers.changed. Required envelope: version=1, provider=modbus-tcp, deliveryId, eventType, occurredAt (UTC ISO milliseconds), accountId, resource as the typed output schema. Omit no required fields; use explicit null where allowed. Filters accountId/resourceId are exact matches; blank disables a filter. At most 100 account+delivery IDs within 96 KiB deduplicate retries per group; state commits on trigger success before downstream completion. Modbus has no native push subscription; this is a relay observation and can miss intermediate changes. Sampling, device load, read errors, change baseline and reconnect are relay responsibilities; ONF starts no TCP listener or polling loop. Sources: https://www.modbus.org/modbus-specifications

setupSteps: Install this reviewed package release; no relay or subscription is installed.
Deploy an independently maintained provider-aware relay which implements the exact provider signature, challenge, authorization and replay rules described below.

Deploy an independently managed read-only Modbus TCP sampling relay restricted to intended unit IDs/register ranges, read function codes 1–4 and authorized private network. Do not expose device TCP ports publicly or issue write functions.

Relay compares bounded read-only samples and emits registers.changed only after an actual value change; its first observation seeds a baseline unless explicitly authorized otherwise. Include unit ID, register table, zero-based start address and complete bounded old/new values. Relay assigns durable delivery IDs and observation timestamps.

Implement the exact canonical version-1 envelope and typed resource schemas documented by each selected trigger; forward one event per POST. Normalize account identity from the authorized provider connection, never from an untrusted request.

Persist one stable delivery ID per logical event across relay retries. Fanout IDs must include distinct native entity/event/status identity (or a persisted record ID); reusing a batch delivery ID or message ID across different statuses drops events. Authorize account/resources; bound payloads to 64 KiB and limit rate.
Save a separate relay-to-ONF callback secret; create a header-authenticated ingress profile for this requirement.
Bind the intended trigger node, configure the relay with its HTTPS callback URL, then deliberately enable workflow and entry.
Review relay limits, delivery identifiers, retries and downstream idempotency; test explicitly before production use.

Select saved node entry mode webhook explicitly; package metadata does not infer it. Create/select a profile for this exact installed requirement (installation.id + "/verified-events"), bind node.trigger.ingress.profileId, save the graph and deliberately enable workflow and entry only when setup is complete.
